scripts.typecheck: bun x tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.json && bun x tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.json && bun x tsc --noEmit -p electron/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: bun run build:server && bun run build:client
scripts.electron: bun run electron:build && bun x electron electron/dist/main.cjs
scripts.electron:build: bun build electron/main.ts --format=cjs --target=node --external electron --outfile=electron/dist/main.cjs && bun build electron/preload.ts --format=cjs --target=node --external electron --outfile=electron/dist/preload.cjs && bun build electron/preload-chat.ts --format=cjs --target=node --external electron --outfile=electron/dist/preload-chat.cjs && bun build electron/preload-lock.ts --format=cjs --target=node --external electron --outfile=electron/dist/preload-lock.cjs
